claim: `MeasurePreserving.map_of_comp` unnecessarily requires `f` to be everywhere measurable; the proof only needs `f` to be a.e. measurable with respect to the source measure, since `f` only appears through `μa.map f`.
requested_change: Weaken the last hypothesis to `(hf : AEMeasurable f μa)` and prove the map equality with `hg.aemeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable hf`; update the call in `MeasurePreserving.of_semiconj` to pass `hfm.aemeasurable`.
